prerequisites.detail: The pro API needs the token scope brain_enhanced_asr.

provider.notes: Registered at gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:1774-1775; dispatched at gateway/src/core/stt/standard.rs:413. MODEL KEY: the model id is Baidu's dev_pid, an integer on the wire, written here as a string. Language is fixed by the dev_pid. An empty model resolves to 1537 (gateway/src/core/stt/baidu/config.rs:39, fallback at :118). EVIDENCE QUALITY: Baidu's documentation hosts could not be reached by the audit or the fact-check. First-hand evidence is Baidu's official GitHub demo code; everything else is a third-party mirror of the official pages or a search excerpt that cites them, and nothing could be tested live. Rows that rest only on second-hand evidence are marked assumed. STREAMING CLIENT (adapter native, known_broken; read from code and official demo code, never run against the vendor; all paths under gateway/src/core/stt/baidu/): (1) The START frame is built from the API Key as 'appid' and the Secret Key as 'appkey' (client.rs:512-519), and appid is a string (messages.rs:27); Baidu's demos send an integer AppID and the API Key. The api_key|secret_key credential (config.rs:470-486) has no place for an AppID, so authentication very probably fails. (2) err_no is a required field of the response (messages.rs:138), so HEARTBEAT frames probably fail to parse. (3) Unknown model ids become 1537 (config.rs:118) and STTConfig.language is never read. (4) Confidence is hard-coded to 1.0 (client.rs:663). The repository mock ignores the START frame (gateway/tests/mock_endpoint_e2e.rs:803-827), so its passing test does not cover the credential mismatch. FILE UPLOAD (adapter regional_rest, not implemented): recognize_short_audio (client.rs:694-767) has no caller, targets https://vop.baidu.com/server_api only (config.rs:404-410), uses a 30 second HTTP timeout (client.rs:80) and returns an error for an empty result or any non-zero err_no (client.rs:756-766). The client's REST mode buffers without limit and never flushes (client.rs:880-883). The OAuth token cache is per client instance; a process-wide cache is needed. The gateway's Baidu error-code table (messages.rs:325) disagrees with the vendor's and must not be reused. From search excerpts of the official error table (not read first-hand): 3300 input parameter incorrect (never retry); 3301 audio quality too poor (a normal no-speech outcome, drop the segment); 3302 authentication failed (refresh the token once); 3303 back-end busy and 3307 back-end recognition error (retry once; the gateway labels 3303 'Audio file too long', messages.rs:341-342); 3304 concurrency exceeded, counted per AppID (back off and retry); 3305 daily quota exceeded; 3308 audio longer than 60 seconds and 3309 audio data problem (never retry). Concurrency is counted per AppID across all callers, so the limiter must be shared by every session on the credential. The adapter picks the endpoint from the row's dialect.wire: baidu_server_api or baidu_pro_api. The file API needs exactly the api_key|secret_key credential the gateway already accepts, so it is the first Baidu transport that can work. STATE TODAY: the streaming client is the native transport, enabled from Release 0, groundwork and honest refusal, and reported as known broken in ready.stt rather than refused (integration decisions, section 15); each native transport carries its defect. The file transport (regional_rest) is enabled from Release 5, wider vendor coverage and hardening, and only after a live probe with a real key (decisions section 12). Until then a model the gateway has no working path for is refused or warned as its when_unusable says. Segmentation is required for 80001 on first-hand evidence; 1637 and 1837 need it only if the socket rejects them, which is unverified. 8001 (a self-trained model, chosen with lm_id) is rowed as file upload only because nothing shows it on the socket. The two far-field ids, 1936 (file API) and 19362 (real-time), are rowed as retired. config/pricing.rs has no Baidu entries, so rows carry no pricing_key.

The dev_pid of a customer's self-trained Mandarin language model on the standard file API (server_api); the model itself is chosen by lm_id, a per-deployment setting recorded as a vocabulary_id context field of the file transport. First-hand: the official REST demo says a self-trained model is called with dev_pid 8001 and its lm_id (and with 80001 and lm_id on pro_api, which follows the 80001 row). Listed as file upload only because nothing shows this id on the real-time socket. Today the gateway silently replaces the id with 1537 (gateway/src/core/stt/baidu/config.rs:118).

provenance.notes: Row key: Baidu's dev_pid, an integer on the wire. Far-field Mandarin on the real-time socket. The id is first-hand: Baidu's official real-time demo names it in a comment as an alternative model. Its retirement is second-hand, which is why the row is marked assumed. The id is not in the gateway's model list, so today the client silently replaces it with 1537 (gateway/src/core/stt/baidu/config.rs:118). The notice recommends real-time Mandarin or short speech instead, hence the replacement ids. Earlier refusal wording (engineering note, replaced 2026-10-04 by customer text): Baidu announced that far-field speech recognition stopped on 2024-12-23, so this real-time far-field model is treated as retired and must be refused at session setup with the replacement ids. Refusal moved from Release 0 to Release 3 on 2026-10-04: a session on this model starts today (today's client serves a different model), and integration decision 12 warns such sessions in Releases 0 to 2 and refuses them from Release 3.

transports.disabled_reason: Not implemented: no file-upload adapter for live calls exists for Baidu. The short-speech request code that exists has no caller. The vendor may reject an unknown model id.

latency.notes: The vendor publishes no absolute latency figure for the standard short-speech API.

rates.note: Counted per AppID across every caller. Search excerpts of the vendor's pages give 2 and 10 for accounts without a purchased pack and 50 with a prepaid pack; which figure applies to which account is unverified, so the lowest is recorded.

gateway_client.notes: JSON body with Base64 audio and an OAuth token. recognize_short_audio (client.rs:694-767) matches Baidu's official demo field for field but has no caller and targets server_api only; details are in the provider notes. An empty result and err_no 3301 (audio quality too poor) are normal no-speech outcomes, not errors.

segment_profile.rationale: 8000 ms is the audit's starting value, not a measurement; it replaces the client's 30 seconds and leaves room for cross-border network time. Raw PCM is preferred over WAV because the request states format and rate explicitly and every Baidu demo uses it. Audio is always sent at 16 kHz. A segment over 60 seconds is a hard error (err_no 3308).

rates.note: With a prepaid pack ('supports 50 concurrent, expandable'), counted per AppID; from an undated third-party mirror of the price list. The default for other accounts is not published.

gateway_client.defect: Known broken against the vendor protocol: the START frame sends the API Key and Secret Key where the vendor expects an integer AppID and the API Key, so the client very probably cannot authenticate. A model id the client does not know is silently replaced by 1537. Repair the client and check it against the live service before enabling.
gateway_client.notes: The defect list with line references is in the provider notes. from_str falls back to 1537 for any id it does not know (config.rs:118).

provenance.notes: Fail-slow default: Baidu has a planned file-upload adapter, so an unknown model id is assumed to need file upload on server_api. Two ids were left without an exact row because no source confirms them, and they land here: 17372 (named once as a real-time English id; if it exists it is a socket-only id, so file upload would be the wrong guess for it) and 1536 (a legacy Mandarin id still in the gateway's model list, absent from the current tables). The gateway sends 1536 verbatim on the socket today (gateway/src/core/stt/baidu/config.rs:76-101) and its plugin metadata advertises it (gateway/src/plugin/builtin/mod.rs:434); confirm it against the live service and give it an exact row, or remove it from the gateway's model list and metadata.
